scope: Native six-scope system map, shared renderer-neutral navigation helpers, retained available local rails, explicit map/flight input ownership and reproducible headless UI timing. Not complete Bevy retirement.

contract.owners: BakedEphemeris owns celestial states; FlightAuthority owns craft and available rails. Both hosts consume flight-authority::navigation scope/cycle/Kepler/rails helpers. The native map does not integrate, request a second forecast, alter physics dt or create another clock/renderer/device/transport.
contract.time: Map bodies and PRIMARY use one newest-authority SimTime; a remote marker is withheld before the first valid snapshot. The interpolated 3D scene may lag but its older planets are never mixed into the newer map. Survey maps use scene presentation time. Future rails subtract reference-body positions at each sample's own epoch.
contract.input: M/HUD switch map and scene. Manual axes, cursor steering, throttle slew and held SAS inversion are neutral in map mode; base SAS, throttle/engine intent and authority advancement remain. Pilot/survey cameras do not receive map gestures. Clock/relaunch keys remain available outside focused-widget capture. Map transitions release held input.
contract.representation: f64 SI camera subtraction and line clipping precede toolkit pixels. Lazy cached parent-relative Kepler curves, body/PRIMARY framing/follow, orbit/pan/zoom, selector/marker picking and collision-filtered labels. Three-pixel body markers are UI outlines, not enlarged physical bodies.
contract.disabled: No map catalogue before first open; no map samples/toolkit draws while closed. Reopen retains the small immutable CPU catalogue. Shared egui buffers are reused; no separate GPU map renderer. Terrain and flight keep updating behind the map.
contract.capture: --map requires an enabled HUD; headless needs --map --hud. Headless toolkit animation time is scripted at 60 presentation frames/s including warmup, independently of physics/sky/audio SimTime. native_map_open is recorded in performance metadata. Capture remains silent.

numeric_oracles.camera: A 1e13 m origin retains the checked 0.03125/0.0625 m offsets; invalid inputs fail closed. A 10000-step orbit sweep preserves a unit frame within 1e-12. Astronomical segments are clipped in f64 before f32 raster vertices.
numeric_oracles.kepler: All baked orbits checked against 2048 dense exact samples each: sampled point-to-segment error <0.001*a metres, closure error <1e-12*a, <=513 vertices per curve. The shared split budget fixes the legacy budget overrun across base intervals. Not a universal arbitrary-orbit or deep-zoom pixel guarantee.
numeric_oracles.rails: 4000-sample moving-reference fixture: future-only projection within 1 mm, <=1025 points including current craft, terminal impact retention, clipped/expired/malformed rejection. Remote mode never creates a local forecast.

diagnostic_history: Preflight clippy rejected chunks_exact with constant width in the new pixel test; replaced with as_chunks. Preserved under target/test-tmp/native-system-map-preflight.

First full run failed the new exact-color pixel oracle although the map was present: wall-time egui fade and display dithering made capture machine-speed-dependent. Scripted headless UI animation time and admitted one encoded LSB of dither. Preserved under native-system-map-first-final.

A later fourteen-command run passed but scene.rs and its remote epoch regression changed during execution; native-system-map-epoch-diagnostic is diagnostic only. The final unchanged-source run supersedes it.
